statements.status_notes: NiFi ships the prebuilt uv binary from astral-sh/uv release 0.12.13, which embeds rustls 0.23.43. GHSA-2mjx-qc3c-rqvc is fixed in rustls 0.23.45. uv 0.12.13 is the latest upstream release and still bundles rustls 0.23.43, so remediation requires a new uv release that bumps its Cargo lock to rustls 0.23.45 or later before NiFi can track it.
